fields.label: Auto Create Purchase Invoice in Branch (Draft)
fields.description: When a Sales Invoice to an internal customer of another company is submitted, create the matching Purchase Invoice (or Debit Note for returns) as a draft in that company

fields.label: Delete Draft Purchase Invoice when Sales Invoice is Cancelled
Update Branch Selling Price from Purchase Rate
fields.description: Selling rate = inter-company purchase rate + profit %. The previous Item Price is closed (Valid Upto = day before) and a new one starts on the invoice date

fields.label: Auto Material Receipt When Stock Is Short
fields.description: When a POS Invoice, Sales Invoice (Update Stock) or Delivery Note is submitted and the warehouse has less than the sold qty, a Material Receipt Stock Entry for the shortfall is created and submitted automatically, then the sale goes through. OFF = standard behaviour: sale is blocked when stock is not available.

fields.label: Receipt Valuation Rate
fields.options:
Item Valuation Rate
Last Purchase Rate
Zero
fields.description: Rate used for the auto receipt. Falls back to the next option when the chosen one is 0.

fields.options: Switching this ON also turns off Block Sale Beyond Available Qty and Validate Stock on Save on every POS Profile so the POS screen does not stop the sale. Switch OFF once opening stock is complete.

fields.label: Company Settings
fields.description: Receiving warehouse and selling price list per branch company. If a company is missing, the warehouse of its POS Profile and Standard Selling are used
